scientific_integrity: The projection-Nijenhuis equivalence and the count of Borel subalgebras are established prior results. Novelty is assessed only for the full eight-rational-orbit classification and sizes, with the square-class splitting. Publication priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields only; \(N^2=N\) Nijenhuis operators on \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\); projective linear adjoint conjugacy only. Geometry of reduced varieties, not the full scheme; finite computations are supportive, not proofs; independent validation not performed.
title: Rational orbit splitting for idempotent Nijenhuis operators on \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\)
